prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Reordering onboarding flow sequences, targeted functional hints (photo upload, path helper, identity security), select layouts (card carousel, single-click identity), key desktop flows (summon, visibility & control), and specific shortcut copy changes drove significant wins.
Harmful changes: Major structural overhauls (split personality redesign, desktop docking setup), spotlight path layouts, account persistence hints, and specific copy changes caused severe performance drops and early test cutoffs.
No clear effect: Wait, progress, and status indicators, background notifications, tutorial or showcase screens, and incentive badges consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: High predicted gains (+8.0% or above) consistently overestimated actual impact, frequently yielding smaller gains, no clear effect, or early test cutoffs.
Predictions too low: Major winning changes—especially key desktop flows, shortcut copy, and story-first reordering—far exceeded low or negative predictions.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Control Practice Flow: Add an interactive practice flow on the final screen teaching users how to summon, move, and hide their pet before completing onboarding. (why: Support receives frequent inquiries after onboarding from users confused about how to control, talk to, or interact with their desktop pet.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Environment Prep Screen: Introduce a system diagnostic screen prior to rendering to check screen permissions and desktop overlay compatibility. (why: Multiple support tickets report pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to open during the home transition (median wait 201s).)
2: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Sync Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that signing in restores and preserves existing pets. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about pets missing or resetting after signing back into an account.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Guidance Hint: Add an explicit photo upload hint guiding users on photo lighting and angle requirements. (why: Support received emails reporting that custom pet generation fails or results look wrong during photo rendering.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Centered Path Selector Layout: Switch the choose path screen layout to a centered layout to focus attention on key onboarding choices. (why: Mean time spent on path selection is currently 514s; a centered layout reduces visual clutter and speeds up choice making.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Time Status Info: Display dynamic render status and progress updates on the desktop waiting screen. (why: Home waiting screen takes a long time (median 201s, mean 2336s), leaving users unsure if pet creation is still progressing.)
6: [finish, incentive] Quick Control Hotkey Unlock Incentive: Highlight desktop shortcut keybindings as an unlocked feature badge on the onboarding completion screen. (why: Users report confusion on how to control pets after onboarding; highlighting shortcut features incentives adoption of desktop controls.)
7: [home, notification] Background Companion Ready Notification: Enable optional background notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when desktop setup finishes. (why: Long render times on the home waiting screen (mean 2336s) cause users to switch windows and miss when their pet is ready.)

scores.note: Key desktop control flow directly aligns with lessons on high-performing desktop interactive features, though requires full flow build.
Tutorial and diagnostic screens historically show no clear effect and require new screen development.
Strong support evidence, but account persistence hints and sign-in copy changes historically cause drops.
Adoption has highest drop-off, photo upload hint is explicitly listed as a winning targeted hint pattern, and cost is minimal.
Choose path layouts have historically shown near-zero lift (+0.1% over 5 tests) with minimal support evidence.
Wait/status indicators consistently show no clear effect despite long home screen wait times.
Incentive badges consistently show no clear effect in previous tests.
Addresses high render wait times, but background notifications fall under historical 'no clear effect' pattern.
